blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines’ high exposure to hazards is driving up its risk of humanitarian crises and disasters, with this factor scoring significantly higher than the country’s vulnerability and lack of coping capacity, an analysis of the European Commission’s 2026 INFORM Risk Index showed. The Philippines scored 5.3 and ranked 45th out of 191 countries in the latest INFORM Risk Index, a European Commission tool that measures countries’ risk of humanitarian crises and disasters. It tied with Mauritania and Colombia and was classified as medium risk, placing third among the 11 Southeast Asian countries included in the index. Only Myanmar, […]...
